in_hebrew.name: Amando
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Amando הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Latin word 'amare' meaning 'to love'. In Christian tradition, the name Amando is given to babies born to parents who cherish their child deeply.

in_latin.name: Amando
